text:
marc: heads up — noticed a reconnect spike right after the SSE circuit-breaker params rolled to canary. console shows a bunch of short-lived sessions and lots of CB trips, but streaming_metrics are almost empty for the same timeframe (sampling looks off).

tess: ugh. which canary? the low-latency routing change?

marc: the new cb.backoff=fast canary we pushed at 09:12. timeline: deploy -> small traffic -> spikes at 09:15.

priya: do we have logs for a broken session? any pattern (route, tenant)?

marc: pasted a minimal log snippet from the proxy: 

```
[09:15:03] conn_id=abcd1234 route=eu-west tenant=acme cb_state=tripped reason=queue_delay_ms>150
[09:15:03] conn_id=abcd1234 reconnecting backoff=200ms
[09:15:03] metrics.sampled=false stream_event=closed
```

marc: note `metrics.sampled=false` — looks like sampling filtered out these streaming events at the proxy level.

dave: ah we enabled low-fraction sampling for high-volume streaming to cut cardinality. canary traffic might be too small so sampled events are zero.

priya: that means console dashboards undercounted the issue during canary. we couldn't see the CB trips because sampled=false.

ops-bot: deploy 1776002400 applied to service/proxy-canary by ci-cd at 09:12:08

marc: two quick asks: (1) should we force higher sampling for canary traffic windows, (2) should we relax the CB so it doesn't trip for short-lived bursts?

tess: for (2) i'm leaning conservative: relax CB thresholds for canary by 2x so we avoid noisy restarts while we observe. for (1) i think we need targeted sampling: force sample=1 for any connection with header `x-rollout-canary: 1` for 10m.

priya: agreed. also add a temporary metric tag `rollout_id` so dashboards can filter specifically. console team complains we can't slice by rollout.

marc: implementation sketch: 

```
# proxy sampling override
if req.headers['x-rollout-canary'] == '1':
  metrics.sampling.rate = 1.0
  metrics.tags['rollout_id'] = REQ.headers['x-rollout-id'] or 'canary-1776002400'
```

marc: and CB change: `cb.queue_delay_threshold_ms = 300` (was 150) and `cb.max_retries=5` for canary.

dave: note: remember to not increase global cardinality. the `rollout_id` tag must be optional and only emitted when present (and for canaries).

priya: agree. also create a lightweight 'probe' event we can emit from the client at connection start so we have a guaranteed metric point even if sampling kicks in later. something like `stream.probe=1` with low-cardinality tags.

marc: good idea. that lets us detect churn even under sampling.

ops-bot: alert created: #INC-2201 "Canary SSE CB trips — missing streaming metrics" assigned to @marc, priority=P2

tess: dashboard work: add a panel with `sum(stream.probe)` and a breakdown by `rollout_id` (show only when rollout_id exists). also expose a console filter to toggle sample-rate-aware view (warns when sample fraction < 1%).

priya: on telemetry: i want a short runbook line: if streaming_metrics count < 50 and cb_trips > 5 in 5m for canary, rollback. otherwise continue with scaled-up sample for 15m and re-evaluate.

marc: ok will implement quick changes: (A) sampling override for canary (B) CB relax for canary (C) probe event emitted from SDK (D) add `rollout_id` tag conditional (E) dashboard panel + runbook. i'll open PRs.

dave: small note: make sure quota calculations don't treat probe as billable tokens. mark probe events with `telemetry_only=true`.

marc: yes — probe events not billed.

priya: can someone pair on dashboard changes? tess?

tess: i can take dashboard, ping me when metrics exist.

marc: timeline: toggle sampling override now, CB relax in next minute, deploy probe to SDK in next 30m, dashboard panel in 1h. will post PR links here.

dave: sounds good. thx. :thumbsup:

marc: PRs: proxy sampling override -> https://git.internal/r/proxy/+/2345, cb relax patch -> https://git.internal/r/tuning/+/2346 (wip). will update when merged.

priya: thanks. follow-up: add console banner during rollouts that warns about sampling sensitivity and points to runbook. reduces ops confusion.

marc: added ticket for console banner.

ops-bot: incident #INC-2201 updated: mitigation steps in progress (sampling override applied), next update scheduled +15m

marc: closing loop here once dashboard shows probe peaks correlated with CB trips. we'll revert sampling override after stable.

priya: documented in runbook draft. leaving thread for async updates.

marc: thanks everyone.
